name: Dynamic Menu Item
description: Creates a dynamic menu item whose target node is set by ticking a checkbox on the node edit form.
project_description: Dynamic Menu Item lets a site create a single, admin-configured menu link (title, description, parent, weight) that is repointed to whichever node an editor selects. After installing, an administrator visits /admin/structure/menu/dynamic_menu_item, sets the menu link's title/description/parent/weight and chooses which content types expose the option. On the node edit form of an enabled content type a checkbox appears (labelled by the configured option title); when an editor ticks it and saves the node, the module creates or updates a menu_link_content link so it points at internal:/node/<nid>. The result is a menu link that always tracks the most recently flagged node.
